listing.name: Luigi's Mansion (Luigi's Mansion Recompiled)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared Luigi’s Mansion Recompiled Windows player with its supported USA or PAL rev0 disc and locally built module. Preserve regional cards, both-disc overlays and actual system/portable data; upstream folder moves can remove the former root.

steps.title: Prepare the exact supported original upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete player/components you are independently permitted to use, with your own GameCube USA GLME01 or Europe GLMP01 revision 0 disc. Supported main.dol SHA1 values are 77d49225e7d28b9777916cdbe5809345c570ecbc (USA) and a1e2bd82813787cfe0b11afb5d138f08fdbd94f1 (PAL rev0). Upstream validates that DOL digest, not merely the image name; ISO/GCM, RVZ and other nod-readable containers are separate representations of that original. Supply both originals only if you want upstream’s cross-region Hidden Mansion overlays. Finish disc selection, local recompilation/link, shader preparation and chosen-version settings outside Portcove. No disc, compiler, converter, helper or game is obtained or executed here.

steps.title: Keep the player and bundled compiler together
steps.instruction: The inspected official 1.1.5 Windows x64 ZIP contains AMD64 LuigisMansionRecomp.exe, matching Aurora/Dawn/SDL3/nod and other libraries plus llvm/bin/clang.exe and lld-link.exe. The runtime builds game/<id>/module.dll locally from the original’s main.dol; the release does not supply that original. Keep the whole package and actual generated data. The port’s decompilation and adapted code use their CC0 scope, Aurora MIT and LLVM Apache-with-exception; these do not relicense the original game.

steps.title: Attach the already prepared normal player
steps.instruction: Select LuigisMansionRecomp.exe, use the complete extracted LuigisMansionRecompiled-1.1.5-windows-x64 directory as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review the exact intent and request Play separately. When configured discs/modules/overlays are current, the integrated setup is skipped and the module is loaded into this same native player. Missing/stale inputs can trigger local rebuilding; complete it upstream before retrying. Do not select a module DLL or compiler as the executable, and do not enable setup-auto, recovery-reset, finite-frame or test overrides.

steps.title: Preserve regional cards and destructive move recovery
steps.instruction: Normally keep the actual %APPDATA%/Luigi's Mansion Recompiled root, including install.ini, settings.ini, game/GLME01 or GLMP01 modules/keys, hidden_mansion/ overlays, USA/Card A and other regional card folders, caches, logs and recovery state. Older Luigi's Mansion PC folders can be renamed on first 1.1+ start; failed rename can copy while retaining the old folder. Existing portable.txt or portable/ instead selects the package-local portable tree. An upstream requested data move copies/checks and switches, then can delete the previous system root; interrupted portable.lm-tmp/portable.lm-old leftovers can be deleted on next startup. Keep independent copies of both old/new roots and any pending move evidence before starting or changing layout. This guide creates no marker and performs no move, recovery, backup or deletion.

steps.title: Maintain the external player and its rights explicitly
steps.instruction: Keep all own-code, decompilation, adapted Dusklight, Aurora and bundled component notices. Original Nintendo assets, other-region content and optional mods require independent permission. Existing external card/cache/source overrides remain authoritative; keep both disc originals and actual relative/absolute install.ini selections. Quit normally before upstream updates or card/data operations, retain independent recovery and review/relink changed executable bytes. The unfinished original two-player content and upstream campaign claims are not native/installed, co-op, gameplay, save/reload or Supported acceptance here. Removing registration preserves external files; managed lifecycle operations remain unavailable.

warnings: Preserve the actual regional cards and both sides of any system/portable data move before startup. First-use builds, automatic stale-module rebuilding and recovery remain upstream-owned.
